Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have aligned next steps: 

- Goal: 4-week pilot to validate latency/cost targets for Acme's customer support use case (multilingual, short-form responses).
- Success criteria: <10% error/irrelevant rate on our eval prompts, average token latency <150ms on p95, and predictable monthly unit cost estimate.
- Data flow: we will use redwood-hosted inference for the pilot; no customer data will be stored beyond retention window.
- Legal / procurement: you mentioned your counsel wants to review standard MSA + SOW redlines.

Next steps:
1) I will send our standard MSA with suggested redlines by EOD Wednesday (Jonas is looped).
2) If procurement/legal have specific timeline constraints, please flag — we can prioritize a one-hour review call with our legal ops.
3) Target kickoff: week of May 11th pending contract.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the redlines shortly.
